highlights: H1 Adjusted PAT reached Rs 29 Cr, up 30% YoY, as operational losses narrowed to Rs 6.1 Cr at the ramping North Bangalore facility. • Patient Volumes Grew 9% YoY (Excluding Fertility): This was supported by healthy demand across network clusters and ongoing bed additions.

Average Revenue Per Patient (ARPP) registered a 7% YoY increase, as positive payor-mix gains (non-institutional mix rising over 300 bps to 69%) were further aided by high-complexity oncology adoption.
Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Outlook remains strong, with management guiding for mid-teens revenue growth and high-teens EBITDA expansion going forward.
The North Bangalore facility's EBITDA loss narrowed to Rs 6.1 Cr with monthly breakeven slated for Q4FY27, alongside 146 operational beds added across the network in H1FY27.
